title: Scopes and borrows
subtitle: Each bar is how long a value lives or how long a borrow must stay valid

presets.label: Valid
presets.text: s lives until the end of main. The borrow r is last used on line 4, well inside that region: the compiler is satisfied.

presets.label: Dangling
presets.text: x is dropped at the end of the inner block (line 6), but r is still used on line 7. The red part of the borrow outlives its referent.

presets.label: longest()
presets.text: 'a must fit inside both inputs. b is dropped at the end of the block (line 11), yet res (which carries 'a) is used on line 12.
